description: This header file defines the interface and constants for telemetry-related functionality, including error codes, an implementation class, and a wrapper class for telemetry API operations.

classes.name: TelemetryApiImpl
classes.description: Abstract class defining telemetry implementation interface with initialization and event reporting methods.

classes.name: TelemetryApi
classes.description: Wrapper class providing static methods to interface with telemetry implementation, including setting implementation and sending events.

methods.name: TelemetryApi(const TelemetryApi &obj)
methods.description: Deleted copy constructor to prevent copying of TelemetryApi instances.

methods.name: setImpl
methods.description: Static method to set the telemetry implementation instance.

methods.name: t2_init
methods.description: Static method to initialize telemetry with a component name.

methods.name: t2_event_s
methods.description: Static method to log a telemetry event with marker and value.
